title: Agent Run Log
description: Observability record for one agent invocation. Constitution: a complex agent team that is not observable is not controllable. One line per agent run.

model.description: Historical logical workload alias after model_policy was applied; it is not a vendor model request. Null means no reasoning seat was dispatched.

runtime_model.description: Optional deployment-bound model id. Omitted by default so the runtime can inherit any provider/model satisfying the seat's capability requirements.

reasoning_effort.description: Optional deployment-specific reasoning setting. Not prescribed by the research architecture.

service_tier.description: Optional deployment-specific service setting. Not prescribed by the research architecture.
